<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word from one insight cited in the same sentence.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>

<previous_draft>
## Problem
Users cannot see how reserves and payments sync with their accounting tools and supplier updates in real time. This lack of transparency makes it hard to trust or adopt the system without a clear demonstration.

## Who is affected
- Commercial and motor insurance accounts, as evidenced by feedback from Marrowgate Commercial, Stannary Commercial, and Sallowmere Motor [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e][i:d1d0b7a8afa0dfaa][i:26e61b44eb162f19].
- The sales route, which has received all three customer mentions on this topic [i:26e61b44eb162f19][i:39d4d6cef8757f3e][i:d1d0b7a8afa0dfaa].

## Evidence
- Three accounts have mentioned this need, representing three total mentions [i:26e61b44eb162f19][i:39d4d6cef8757f3e][i:d1d0b7a8afa0dfaa].
- All feedback has come via a single route: sales [i:26e61b44eb162f19][i:39d4d6cef8757f3e][i:d1d0b7a8afa0dfaa].
- The combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of the two accounts with known ARR is 2,140,000 GBP [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e][i:d1d0b7a8afa0dfaa]. Marrowgate Commercial contributes 1,600,000 GBP, and Stannary Commercial contributes 540,000 GBP [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e][i:d1d0b7a8afa0dfaa].
- Two of these accounts are up for renewal within the next 90 days [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e][i:d1d0b7a8afa0dfaa]. Stannary Commercial renews on 2026-12-05, and Marrowgate Commercial renews on 2026-12-12 [i:d1d0b7a8afa0dfaa][i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].
- A representative from Sallowmere Motor asked, "That sounds promising. Can we see how reserves and payments sync with our existing accounting tools?" [i:26e61b44eb162f19].
- A representative from Marrowgate Commercial stated, "Yes, that’d be helpful — especially if we can see how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates in real time" [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e].
- A representative from Stannary Commercial requested a demo, saying, "Perfect. Can we set up a demo next week? I’d like to see how reserves and payments flow through the system" [i:d1d0b7a8afa0dfaa].

## Why Now
Two key accounts, representing 2,140,000 GBP in ARR, have renewal dates in early December 2026 [i:39d4d6cef8757f3e][i:d1d0b7a8afa0dfaa]. Their explicit requests for visibility into reserves and payments flow, made in September and October 2026, indicate this is a critical factor for trust and adoption ahead of these renewals [i:d1d0b7a8afa0dfaa][i:39d4d6cef8757f3e]. Furthermore, a third prospect, Sallowmere Motor, has raised the same need during a sales conversation in October 2026 [i:26e61b44eb162f19].
</previous_draft>
